As a company we are all laser focused on enabling a scalable model of care which empowers healthcare staff and improves patient outcomes. The DPP supports this by setting up digital pathways which are remote-first and asynchronous. As pathways harness sophisticated automation, clinical algorithms and intelligent co-horting, patients always take the optimised route through their pathway, thereby delivering a step change in clinical productivity. The role We're looking for a Senior Node.js Engineer to work closely with our product & client facing teams, understand our customer challenges, and ship things quickly to test & learn. You will design, scope, build and deploy new features quickly for our users. You will have high ownership over whole areas of the codebase and who features end-to-end, contributing to a platform that supports millions of patient interactions. You should be biased towards pace and experimentation and excited about solving the big challenges in healthcare. What you'll do Build the platform that will allow our clients to look after their patients, integrating new data sources to drive our DPP, managing those complex clinical data flows to ensure that data is where it needs to be, and then writing updates back to 3rd party systems. Own services in production, including monitoring, debugging, and improving reliability over time Collaborate with product and design to deliver user-focused solutions Support and improve our cloud infrastructure Outcomes you'll be responsible for Deliver high-quality, maintainable backend systems that scale with growing usage Take ownership of features/services and ensure they are reliable in production Support and mentor other engineers through collaboration and code review Champion technical excellence and continuous improvement by driving best practices in software development, DevOps, and cloud infrastructure Team You will be joining a lean & high performing engineering organisation. We value pace, but also hold really high quality standards for each other. The structure: You will be a member of our Backend/Platform team. As a Senior Engineer, you will report directly to our Platform/Backend Lead. Cross-functional collaboration: You'll work in a tight loop with our Product, Design, and Frontend teams. Our Tech & Tools We lean into modern, scalable infrastructure (Node.js, TypeScript, GCP). We prioritise tools that enable velocity - such as Terraform and automated CI/CD. We also lean heavily into AI, and you'll be able (encouraged) to use whatever tools you need to scale your own and the team’s workflows As a Person You're a proactive Engineer who enjoys collaborating with all areas of the business and our customers directly You're Passionate about solving complex problems in a team of brilliant people You bring empathy and enthusiasm to help the wider team progress through mentoring. You'll bring strong experience in GCP and backend design, and support others through collaboration and knowledge sharing You'll be super curious & love pushing the boundaries of agentic coding & scaling your own abilities As a Developer You'll have professional experience as a Senior Developer Ideally in a start up Ideally ~5+ years as a developer On that journey, you'll have worked with lots of variety (exhaustive list below, not all required!): Writing code: Deep understanding of best practices when building Node.js applications with Typescript & experience integrating with a variety of APIs, e.g. REST & SOAP Cloud experience: Hands-on experience with cloud infrastructure. Ideally Google Cloud Platform, although not required. E.g: Datastore, Cloud Run, Cloud Functions, IAM, Docker Networking: Solid understanding of VPCs, subnets, private VPNs CI/CD: automation

review_candidates.title: Senior Software Engineer, Backend
review_candidates.description: Apply Description Job Title: Senior Software Engineer, Backend Location: Remote (United States) Reports To: Engineering Manager Department: Product Development FLSA Status: Exempt Planet Depos is a leading global court reporting firm that harnesses innovative technology to streamline proceedings and deliver better outcomes for clients. As the only international firm led by industry experts, our team is dedicated to reshaping the field with cutting-edge, technology-driven services, including Planet Pro™, our AI-powered litigation technology suite. We are replacing the legacy platform that runs our scheduling, billing and file workflows with a platform built in-house, and we need a senior backend engineer to help build it. You will work closely with an architect and a front-end lead, building systems that legal professionals and court reporters rely on every day. You will design and build services and data models, help decide how they fit together, and work with the team to move production workflows off the old platform without disrupting the people who depend on them. Essential Job Responsibilities Design, build and maintain backend services and APIs in TypeScript and Node.js. Design and evolve relational database schemas (we use PostgreSQL), including migrating data from a legacy system into a standardized model. Build and consume event-driven integrations over a message broker. Partner with product and engineering leads to turn requirements into work the team can estimate and deliver. Write automated tests (unit, integration and end-to-end) and keep CI/CD pipelines healthy. Review code, and mentor and support other engineers. Troubleshoot production issues and help turn incidents into permanent fixes. Document the systems you build so others can run and extend them. Compensation & Benefits Annual Salary: $150,000 - $185,000, commensurate with experience Planet Depos Also Offers a Comprehensive Benefits Package Medical insurance Dental insurance Vision insurance Health Savings Account Voluntary Term Life Insurance Voluntary Long-Term Disability Paid Time Off Paid Holidays 401(k) Employee Assistance Program (EAP) Requirements Required (all three of the following, with specific examples): Production backend experience. 7+ years building and running backend services. For example: a service you owned from design to production; an API whose contract you changed without breaking its consumers; a performance or reliability problem you traced to its cause. Strong data modeling. Hands-on experience with relational databases; any is fine, and we use PostgreSQL. For example: a schema you designed or reshaped; a data migration you planned and verified; how you handled data that did not fit the new model. Delivery habits. You test your work, make small, reviewed changes, and ship regularly. For example: how you structure a change so it can be released safely; a release that went wrong and what you changed afterward. Also Required Clear written and verbal communication. A degree in computer science or a related field, or equivalent experience. Preferred TypeScript and Node.js on a service framework such as NestJS. Event-driven architecture with RabbitMQ or a similar broker. AWS (for example data migration services, serverless, monitoring). Infrastructure as code (Terraform) and CI/CD pipelines. Trunk-based development, feature flags and continuous deployment. Replacing or migrating away from a legacy system. GraphQL, REST and WebSockets; API gateway products. Agile Scrum teams. EOE M/F/D/V

The Engineer owns services end to end, from design and implementation through testing, deployment, reliability, and support. Strong software engineering skills with experience designing reliable, testable, and maintainable services. Experience with AI gateway, orchestration, entitlements, tenancy, metering, quotas, or similar platform capabilities. Ability to design APIs and developer experiences for internal and external consumers. Experience with multi-tenant systems, tenant isolation, service boundaries, and platform-level enforcement patterns. Experience building integration frameworks, connector patterns, governed data access, or reliable data on-ramps. Strong understanding of retries, partial failure, consistency, idempotency, back-pressure, and operational failure modes. Experience owning services through design, development, testing, deployment, monitoring, and support. Strong communication and collaboration skills for client-facing consulting environments. Pragmatic mindset with the ability to ship meaningful value quickly while maintaining engineering quality. Desired Qualifications Experience with C#, Python, Go, or similar backend languages. Experience with event-sourced metering, quotas, entitlements, or billing-related platform services. Experience building enterprise-scale software used by multiple products, customers, or internal teams. Experience using AI-assisted development tools while maintaining strong review, testing, and architecture discipline.

review_candidates.title: MES Software Engineer
review_candidates.description: About Eagle Wireless Eagle Wireless is building the connective tissue of the physical world. Every connected car, every industrial sensor, every IoT device that needs to talk to the cloud reliably and securely — that’s where we come in. We design and deliver cellular modules and connectivity solutions that automotive, and IoT companies trust to work for years, in the field, without compromise. Our teams span North America, Europe, and APAC, giving you the chance to collaborate with world-class engineers and go-to-market experts solving hard problems at global scale — from cybersecurity and supply chain resilience to regulatory compliance across dozens of markets. If you want your work to matter in a world that’s rapidly connecting everything, and you want to do it alongside people obsessed with getting the hard stuff right, Eagle Wireless is where that happens. Job Summary Join our internal software team to develop and extend our in-house Manufacturing Execution System (MES). You'll work directly with our electronics manufacturing line to integrate production equipment, build end-to-end product traceability, and connect manufacturing data with operations and fulfillment systems. Key Duties & Responsibilities Develop and maintain MES services that integrate with production line equipment, inspection systems, and line management software. Design and implement traceability across work orders, serial numbers, parts, lots, and material consumption. Integrate MES data with operations, fulfillment, and ERP systems. Maintain production databases, including schema changes, data retention, and backups. Deploy, monitor, and troubleshoot MES services. Build operator-facing tools for job setup and production preparation. Work on the production floor with operators and manufacturing staff to understand processes and resolve issues. Qualifications/Skills/Knowledge 0–5 years of software development experience, including production systems. Strong programming skills (we use Python). Experience designing and working with relational databases. Experience building and maintaining integrations between systems. Data modeling experience, ideally for traceability, inventory, or transactional systems. Experience supporting live systems where downtime has a business impact. Ability to work from limited documentation and make design decisions independently. Solid programming fundamentals. Ability to learn new tools and systems quickly. Interest in manufacturing and working hands-on with production equipment. MES, manufacturing, industrial, or embedded software experience. Electronics manufacturing environments. ERP integration. Production metrics and reporting. Internship, co-op, or project experience in manufacturing. Our work environment is collaborative, and we offer a competitive compensation and benefits package, which includes medical/dental/vision, generous PTO, and paid parental leave programs. Eagle Wireless recognizes the importance of forming inclusive teams to foster an environment where creative solutions are made for our clients, and all have the opportunity to thrive and succeed. We encourage candidates from a variety of backgrounds to apply to be a part of our team.
